name: niffler-cc
//: Development project for editors and the TypeScript language server. The builder compiles the component from cc/main.ts in its own generated project (var/build/cc of the harness that builds it) and resolves the imports below itself, so this file is never part of a build — it exists so `npm install` + `tsc --noEmit` (or any LSP) see the same module graph the builder will.
